source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The requester wants independent, randomly selected complex photographic concepts that can visibly test whether pose-semantics keywords survive candidate-pack composition and image rendering, using the attached portrait as an appearance reference. Arm-01 independently selects a polar planetary-analogue field-science event and an agent-selected pose interpretation, not a requester-supplied definition.
subject: One clearly adult woman planetary field scientist whose facial appearance is guided only by the attached portrait reference.
setting: An Antarctic blue-ice meteorite survey field at polar twilight, with a numbered survey flag, foam-lined sample tray, and tripod spectrometer.
event: A katabatic gust exposes a dark meteorite while the scientist lowers it with sampling tongs toward the tray amid curling spindrift.
visual_priorities: A continuous full-body serpentine pose with clearly opposed pelvis and thorax directions
A visibly relaxed offset wrist plus fully readable feet, opaque polar clothing, and field-science action
baseline_prompt_en: Documentary expedition photograph at polar twilight on an Antarctic blue-ice field. One clearly adult woman planetary field scientist, her facial appearance guided by the attached portrait, wears a fully opaque expedition-red insulated parka zipped to the chin, black bib trousers, thick gloves, gaiters, and polar boots. A katabatic gust exposes a charcoal meteorite beside a numbered flag while she lowers it with long sampling tongs toward a blue foam-lined tray; airborne spindrift ribbons across the ice. Her full-body stance traces a continuous figura serpentinata: weight settles over a bent left leg, the right foot sets diagonally back, her pelvis turns toward the tray, her thorax and shoulders rotate in the opposite direction toward a tripod spectrometer, and her head returns toward the sample. Her free gloved hand hangs beside her hip with a gentle outward relaxed wrist offset. Photograph her full-body, from head to both fully visible boots, with all limbs readable. Low polar sun and faint aurora reflections delineate the twist, fabric volume, ice striations, and flying snow.
